description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 on condition the cost is negligible (relayed by GC: "A: only if the cost is negligible").

Why: fz-9x7.8 round 6's time-weighted in-use is sampled only at gc events, so it is biased (on survive V0 it holds 17 MB across a gap where in-use reached its 101 MB peak). The pool keeps an exact integral instead: in-use changes only at block-pool and binary allocate/free events; at each, integral += in_use x (pool bytes allocated since the last event). One multiply-add and two counters per event, nothing per object, no clock reads; the figure is deterministic.

Negligible gate (pre-registered): median instructions within +0.06% of base on every workload (bottom of the noise band). Any workload above it fails and the ticket is dropped.

Then: the round-6 arms of fz-9x7.8 are rebuilt over it and clauses 1 and 4 re-judged with this mean in place of the gc-sampled figure; nothing else changes.
title: run_ended reports the mean of in-use bytes, weighted by bytes allocated
